lines: There assembled by pair of wheels unity shines; by reversal but, having thrown twofold-condition, moves thence.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra saṅghaṭṭitaṃ cakrayugmamaikyena bhāsate vaiparītyāttu nikṣipya dvidhābhāvaṃ vrajatyataḥ
